sources.document: Clasificacion de los cuerpos de agua continentales superficiales
admissible_claims: Cuenca Jequetepeque is official hydrologic unit 13774
Rio Contumaza, Rio Chilete and Rio San Miguel are classified watercourses within unit 13774
Cuenca Chaman is a distinct official hydrologic unit 137752 and must not be merged into Jequetepeque
forbidden_inferences: Chepen is a river or basin
Cuenca Chaman is a Jequetepeque child for IRFEN
watercourse classification supplies event outcomes
provider classes are IRFEN thresholds

sources.document: Informe Tecnico A6769 - Evaluacion geologica de las zonas afectadas por El Nino Costero 2017 en La Libertad-Cajamarca
admissible_claims: the official 2017 assessment covers Cuenca Jequetepeque among affected La Libertad-Cajamarca systems
the assessment records exceptional growth of Rio Jequetepeque inundating and eroding agricultural land on both margins in San Miguel, Cajamarca
forbidden_inferences: the documented San Miguel reach proves uniform lower-valley flooding
the report supplies a basinwide event footprint
all mapped 2017 hazards in Pacasmayo or Chepen are caused by Rio Jequetepeque
absence of a named sector is a negative control

sources.document: Reporte Complementario 2456 - erosion fluvial en Magdalena, Cajamarca
admissible_claims: on 23 February 2023 intense rainfall increased Rio Jequetepeque flow and eroded the Cajamarca-Magdalena road platform in Magdalena district
forbidden_inferences: the event supplies a basinwide inundation polygon
the reported response transfers to every tributary or lower-valley reach
the event defines an IRFEN discharge threshold

sources.institution: INDECI / COEN using SENAMHI hydrologic monitoring
sources.document: 2023 hydrologic bulletins for Rio Jequetepeque - Estacion Yonan GORE
admissible_claims: official 2023 bulletins document time-stamped Rio Jequetepeque flow observations at Yonan GORE
the station is a candidate observation source for event reconstruction after QA and station-to-reach linkage
forbidden_inferences: provider yellow/orange/red bands are IRFEN decision thresholds
a single station value represents every basin child
bulletin potential-impact lists are observed event footprints

sources.document: Consultar la informacion hidrometrica de la presa Gallito Ciego
admissible_claims: PEJEZA publishes hydrometric variables for Gallito Ciego including reservoir level, storage, inflow and outflow components
the service identifies Yonan and Las Paltas as inflow observation points
forbidden_inferences: reservoir operation values are natural-response labels
authorized or outlet discharges define historical channel capacity
provider operational values are IRFEN thresholds

sources.document: Gallito Ciego operation, monitoring and maintenance context
admissible_claims: PEJEZA is the operator of the Gallito Ciego major hydraulic infrastructure and reports reservoir and drainage maintenance activities
forbidden_inferences: current maintenance proves past hydraulic capacity
regulated downstream response can be treated as unregulated natural response
works are event footprints or negative evidence
